title: A new round of building across the empire. Bridges and madrasas go up in the new lands, a madrasa among them at al-Ushbūna, and a chain of acequias, irrigation canals fed from the hills, is dug along the great river from the capital to Qurṭuba to feed the growing population

acequia.text: a sophisticated irrigation canal system bringing water from mountain streams to fields and gardens, enabling intensive agriculture (the game's text)

data.note: names as the game shows them on Trent's construction list, which runs on beyond the screen; completion due 136 to 291 days after the order

source: Trent's account, construction list and map screen, 14 August 1397

title: The explorations go on as the empire's explorers round the coast of Africa and push south. Two of the Emperor's kin lead them: his brother-in-law Muḥammad al-Aḥmar charts the Canary Islands, and his cousin Ismāʿīl ibn Muḥammad al-ʿĀbid the seas of southern Macaronesia toward Cape Verde

Canary Islands.explorer: Muḥammad ibn Ismāʿīl al-Aḥmar, 64 (51/70/60), explorer from 10 February 1396

southern Macaronesia (Cape Verde).explorer: Ismāʿīl ibn Muḥammad al-ʿĀbid, 47 (40/36/66), explorer from 19 February 1396

data.alreadyKnown: the north-west African coast and the seas of the Azores and Madeira
data.rivals: Castile is exploring the Azores; another power is in the Madeira sea
data.note: Khayr al-Dīn al-Jayyānī's voyage of 1391 and the Azores and Madeira expeditions of 1392 are no longer active in the save; their explorers' names are not recorded there

source: Trent's account, August 1397; autosave of 1 June 1397
